conflicts.title: eCFR currency metadata inconsistent for Title 34
conflicts.description: Live eCFR pages blocked automated retrieval, and search metadata reported inconsistent last-amended and currency dates across Title 34 pages in a single session. Currency was established from the govinfo annual CFR edition and the Cornell mirror instead. SRC-004 is therefore recorded CONFLICTED.
conflicts.resolution_owner: Founder / Operator, with qualified legal review
conflicts.resolution_route: Manual eCFR check before any determination relies on the amendment state of 34 CFR Part 99, 98 or 300.

conflicts.title: CycloneDX ratified standard and latest specification are different versions
conflicts.description: ECMA-424 first edition corresponds to CycloneDX 1.6, while OWASP released specification v1.7 in October 2025 without Ecma ratification, and a 2.0 release was announced but not released. Current version depends on which authority is meant.
conflicts.resolution_route: The evidence pipeline must state the CycloneDX specVersion it emits rather than referring to CycloneDX generally.

conflicts.title: Massachusetts personal information is narrower than education-record PII
conflicts.description: Personal information under c. 93H and 201 CMR 17.00 requires a name combined with a Social Security number, driver's licence or state ID, or financial account number. Most student-record data does not meet that definition, yet is fully covered by 603 CMR 23.00 and FERPA. Conflating the two regimes would misstate both.
conflicts.resolution_owner: Founder / Operator, with qualified legal review
conflicts.resolution_route: The register keeps the two regimes on separate obligation records and never merges their triggers.

conflicts.title: Regulated accessibility version differs from the current W3C Recommendation
conflicts.description: ADA Title II and the HHS Section 504 rule both name WCAG 2.1 Level AA. The current W3C Recommendation is WCAG 2.2. Building only to the regulated version leaves a re-test cycle; building to 2.2 exceeds what regulation names.
conflicts.resolution_route: Owner decision recorded through OBL-014, binding ULW-AS-001 v1.3 to a named WCAG version.

conflicts.title: EOTSS accessibility policy scope unresolved
conflicts.description: The Massachusetts enterprise accessibility policy binds executive-branch agencies. Whether and how it reaches school districts or their vendors was not established, and the policy version and conformance level were not retrieved.
conflicts.resolution_owner: Founder / Operator, with qualified legal review
conflicts.resolution_route: Retrieve the policy text and its scope clause before any Massachusetts procurement response.

conflicts.title: COPPA statutory citation range varies across FTC pages
conflicts.description: FTC materials cite both 15 U.S.C. 6501-6505 and 6501-6506 for the same statute.
conflicts.resolution_route: Confirm against the U.S. Code before the citation appears in any formal memo.

stale_references.project_reference: ULW-AS-001 v1.3 as the accessibility standard, with no stated WCAG version binding
stale_references.verified_current: WCAG 2.2 is the current W3C Recommendation. ADA Title II and the HHS Section 504 rule name WCAG 2.1 Level AA.
stale_references.notes: The internal standard is not wrong. It is unbound to an external version, which makes its coverage unstateable.

stale_references.project_reference: Trigger gate wording BEFORE LIVE PII in the capability architecture
stale_references.verified_current: The first binding obligation may attach through Massachusetts narrow personal information, including operator payroll or payment data, before any student PII exists.
stale_references.notes: The gate name implies student data is the first trigger. OBL-009 shows it may not be.

stale_references.project_reference: CycloneDX described without a specification version
stale_references.verified_current: ECMA-424 corresponds to CycloneDX 1.6; OWASP v1.7 was released October 2025 and is not Ecma ratified.
stale_references.notes: Routed through CNF-002. The emitted specVersion must be named.

stale_references.project_reference: Zero-PII boundary asserted across governance documents
stale_references.verified_current: Verified accurate at WP-038 with one refinement: the interface sets a first-party sidebar preference cookie, and platform error reporting is invoked only when the host injects it.
stale_references.notes: Recorded so that a future no-cookies claim is not made by accident.

stale_references.project_reference: References to WCAG without a version or level
stale_references.verified_current: Any accessibility statement must name both a version and a conformance level to be meaningful.
stale_references.notes: Rolled into FND-016 rather than raised separately.

data_triggers.prerequisite_review: Legal review plus an executed district data privacy agreement
data_triggers.minimum_necessary: Identifier, enrolment relationship and program status only. No free-text narrative in the first model.
data_triggers.retention_question: Which record type is the transcript equivalent and which is the temporary record?
data_triggers.disclosure_question: Who may see a student outside the assigned service relationship, and under what recorded purpose?

data_triggers.prerequisite_review: Legal review; IDEA confidentiality analysis; Ed-Fi domain mapping
data_triggers.minimum_necessary: Program participation and service delivery facts. Not clinical narrative.
data_triggers.retention_question: What triggers destruction when services end?
data_triggers.disclosure_question: How is disability status prevented from leaking through interface projections and search?

data_triggers.prerequisite_review: Security review before any authentication is added
data_triggers.minimum_necessary: Account identifier and acting capacity. No personal contact detail beyond what authentication requires.
data_triggers.retention_question: How long does an inactive account persist?
data_triggers.disclosure_question: Is any operator identity rendered on a public surface?

data_triggers.data_class: Payroll, payment or government identifier data
data_triggers.prerequisite_review: 201 CMR 17.00 written information security program must exist first
data_triggers.minimum_necessary: Handled by a processor wherever possible rather than held.
data_triggers.retention_question: What is the disposal standard, including third-party disposal?
data_triggers.disclosure_question: Who inside the organisation can reach it?

data_triggers.prerequisite_review: Privacy review; surveillance-metric refusal rules already prohibit individual monitoring
data_triggers.minimum_necessary: Aggregate system health only. No per-student or per-staff behavioural profile.
data_triggers.retention_question: What is the shortest useful retention window?
data_triggers.disclosure_question: Could an aggregate be re-identified in a small district or low-incidence program?

data_triggers.minimum_necessary: Free text is the least controllable data class and should be bounded or avoided.
data_triggers.retention_question: Does correspondence containing student detail become part of the education record?
data_triggers.disclosure_question: How is inadvertent student PII in free text detected and removed?
